messages:
deploy-bot: initiating staged rollout: service=semantic-search, from=redwood/sem-v5.0.0 to=redwood/sem-v5.1.0, target=5% (eu-west), rollout_id=rl-5012, change_window=2026-04-05T16:00Z..17:00Z
release-manager: release notes up: https://go/redwood/releases/sem-5.1.0. Key: tokenizer reorder + KV cache compaction. QA green on small set.
sam: quick Q — is this the compact-kv build or the default? any runtime overrides planned?
naomi: compact-kv enabled for canary, runtime flag kv.compact=true. Perf expect ~1.8x lower mem.
sre-oncall: watching p99, 5xx, and kvcache.evictions. Auto-rollback rule: 5xx > 0.5% for 10m OR kvcache.evictions > 40 in 5m -> rollback.
infra: pinning canary to eu-west-2a to reduce noise.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 5% eu-west. phase=running.
sam: seeing an uptick in tokenizer timeouts on a small subset (host=tokenizer-eu-4). p50/p95 fine, p99 spikes.
sre-oncall: looking at traces: tokenizer_rpc latency spikes, sample log:
```
[2026-04-05T16:03:12Z] req=9c1a tokenizer_rpc_ms=1600 host=tokenizer-eu-4
[2026-04-05T16:03:47Z] req=9c1b resp_status=502 downstream=tokenizer
```
naomi: hmm that could be compaction GC pressure. Can we throttle canary concurrency and enable permissive-tokenize flag?
sre-oncall: applying concurrency override to 6 and requesting runtime flag kv.compact_gc_pause=true for canary.
deploy-bot: updated rollout config: overrides={concurrency:6} and runtime flag applied: rl-5012.kv.compact_gc_pause=true.
infra: applying node pin; scheduler should rebalance in ~90s.
sam: after override p99 improved a bit but still noisy. What's our decision — stop, throttle, or rollback?
release-manager: prefer to HOLD at 5% and triage. No rollback from PM. If anyone wants immediate rollback, type exactly "rollback" in-thread.
sre-oncall: I'll keep aggressive watch and will trigger auto-rollback if evictions cross threshold. Also added scraper for tokenizer.rpc_timeouts > 3 in 5m -> page.
naomi: opening ticket GH-4801 to investigate GC tuning and compaction scheduling. Will test incremental GC fixes in canary dev cluster.
deploy-bot: phase=paused (manual_hold) rollout_id=rl-5012 current_pct=5 note=concurrency-limited+gc-pause-flag
infra: noted; observing reduced mem churn on tokenizer-eu-4.
sam: thanks. I'll keep sampling outputs and post any failed traces.
release-manager: thanks team — holding until 16:20Z. Next check-in 16:20Z or sooner if signal. :eyes:
